messages:
amanda_sales: Driftly asking for a short perf POC before signing. Mix: streaming chat (1-2k tokens) + embeddings. Can we run a 30m smoke+burst test Wed 09:00 UTC?

lina_se: Targets? They called out ~200 qps sustained, microbursts to 1k rps, p95 <400ms gen / <120ms embed.

raj_eng: Proposed: 10m warmup @50qps, 20m sustained @200qps, 5x60s bursts @1krps spaced 2m. Capture p50/p95/p99/p999, errors, GPU/CPU, KV cache hit, fallback counts.

jordan_sre: Add cross-AZ egress noise and monitor queued_requests + model_fallback metric. Ill stand up Grafana and share link.

ops_bot: Reserved infra: 2x A100-equivalent, autoscale off, logs -> ephemeral S3.

security_bot: For POC we can offer tenant KMS on Dedicated, redacted hosted logs for demo, SOC2 summary. HSM/key rotation requires Private.

harry_sales: Customer wants cost delta for quantized vs fp16 to assess tradeoffs. Can engineering provide a quick estimate?

raj_eng: Ballpark: quantized ~1.6-1.8x throughput uplift and ~40-50% GPU cost reduction in similar runs. Will deliver exact numbers post-run.

lina_se: Post-run deliverable: concise writeup with p50/p95/p99, error rates, KV hit, cost sketch, and notes on any fallbacks.

amanda_sales: Thanks all. Please share Grafana link + final run window by EOD and I'll confirm with Driftly. Thread closed unless blockers.
